about: Evidence for the Results timeline. Every checkpoint is a time point a cited study actually measured; numbers are only those reported in the PubMed abstract. change_* values are positive for improvement. kind: change (size of change in the named measure), responders (share of people who improved), ratio (times the plain-product improvement), protective (difference vs occasional use), qualitative (improvement reported without a size). Each checkpoint carries the grade of the study it cites (grade); the entry's evidence_strength is its best checkpoint.

grades.B: smaller or less controlled randomised study
grades.C: open-label, uncontrolled, review of low-quality trials, or a blend

population.deeper_tones: limited data for deeper skin tones

checkpoints.plain: In a study of 100 people, oil production was measurably lower than with a plain moisturiser after 2 weeks.
Oil production stayed lower than with a plain moisturiser at 4 weeks.
In a second, smaller study, surface oil was lower at 6 weeks (oil production itself did not change significantly).

checkpoints.plain: In a single-product study, a first improvement in the look of dark spots was seen from week 2.
In a 42-person study, a cream with 2% tranexamic acid and 2% niacinamide reduced the look of uneven pigmentation more than a plain cream, on top of sunscreen.
By week 12, spot pigment readings were lower than at the start in a single-product study.
In 50 people with a diagnosed pigment condition (not typical shoppers), a 5% cream reduced a severity score by about half (−50.9%) at 12 weeks.

entries.beyond_last_study: maintenance: results usually hold with continued use; no evidence of further change

checkpoints.plain: In an open study of 120 Indian women (no comparison group), pigment in dark spots was about 16% lower after 3 months, using a product that also contained another active and a daily sunscreen.

entries.beyond_last_study: maintenance: results usually hold with continued use; no evidence of further change
entries.note: The study product combined alpha arbutin with another active and sunscreen, so the effect can't be credited to arbutin alone.
